title: Oozey Citrusy Spanish Tomato Stir-fry
description: A bouncy-qq date-night dish featuring Thai red curry paste, namul-blanch-seasoned tomatoes, and ovo-vegetarian-friendly ingredients that ooze with citrusy goodness.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add Thai red curry paste and garlic cloves, stirring for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Crack eggs into the pan and scramble them gently with a spatula.
Slice Spanish tomatoes and add to the pan. Stir-fry until they start to soften but are still slightly crunchy.
Season with citrus zest juice, salt to taste, and thyme (if using).
Add onion rings and Thai basil leaves. Cook for another minute until everything is well combined.
Remove from heat and serve immediately as a light side dish or main course.
